# `vox-code-audit`

**Crate:** `vox-code-audit` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

AI code quality stub detector — finds stubs, magic values, empty bodies, missing references, and DRY violations

## Crate Overview

# vox-code-audit

**T**odo, **O**mitted wiring, **E**mpty bodies, **S**tub functions,
**T**oo-early victory, **U**nresolved references, **B**roken DRY — detector.

TOESTUB mechanically detects AI coding anti-patterns that are banned by
AGENTS.md but otherwise only caught during manual review.

Public modules and re-exports are intentionally thin; each detector/rule is documented in its
own file where non-obvious heuristics exist.

## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `diagnostics` | Stable diagnostic ID catalog (`vox/<category>/<name>` scheme) and explain infrastructure. |
| `ai_analyze` | Optional LLM-backed triage: wraps provider-specific clients behind a small `AiAnalyzer` API. |
| `analysis` | Token maps, optional `syn` AST, and other shared analysis for detectors. |
| `detectors` | Concrete TOESTUB rules (stubs, empty bodies, secrets, DRY, …) registered by [`detectors::all_rules`]. |
| `run_context` | Per-run canary / rollout flags for detectors (set by [`engine::ToestubEngine`]). |
| `suppression` | Structured suppression store (`contracts/toestub/suppression.v1.schema.json`). |
| `retirement_parity` | CR-L6 retirement-guard parity check — cross-references `contracts/retirement/retired-surfaces.v1.yaml` against the registered detectors and diagnostic IDs. Library home of the planned `vox ci retirement-audit` CLI command. |
| `stdlib_parity` | Stdlib-coverage parity check (non-CR-L tooling gate). Three-way diff between binary registrations in `crates/vox-compiler/src/eval/builtins.rs`, doc claims in `docs/src/reference/ref-builtins-stdlib.md`, and corpus call sites under `scripts/`. Library home of the `vox audit stdlib-coverage` subcommand. See `docs/src/architecture/vox-stdlib-gap-audit-2026-05-23.md` §10 / §12.D. |
| `engine` | Runs configured detectors over a [`scanner::Scanner`] snapshot and aggregates [`rules::Finding`]s. |
| `report` | Renders findings to the terminal, JSON, or Markdown for CI and local CLI output. |
| `review` | End-to-end **code review** flow: prompts, provider adapters (OpenAI, Ollama, …), SARIF/MD emit. |
| `rules` | Shared model for a single finding, severity/language enums, and the [`rules::DetectionRule`] trait. |
| `scanner` | Collects `SourceFile` entries from a repo path with language detection from extensions. |
| `task_queue` | In-memory bounded work queue used to cap parallel file/review tasks. |
